user.title: Pebble Index
user.description:
How to get the token:

1. Open {index_link} and sign in with the same account as the Pebble mobile app.
2. Press **F12** (macOS: **⌥⌘I**) and switch to the **Console** tab.
3. Paste this line and press Enter:

```
{snippet}
```

4. Copy the string it prints, without the surrounding quotes.
5. Paste it below.

The token renews itself, so this is a one-time step. Note that it grants full access to your Index account — notes and transcripts too, not only the shopping list.

data_description.refresh_token: A long string starting with A… — paste it without quotes.
